title: spend_ledger_line
description: One line of the monthly spend ledger (<ledger dir>/YYYY-MM.jsonl): one provider response or charged failure, estimated at list price (ADR-023).

usd.description: estimated list-price cost; unpriced models at the fallback cap rate

usd_known.description: false when the model had no price row

estimated.description: true when no usage was reported and the pessimistic cost was charged
